mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of a near-term recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in > 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 93.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals a weakening economy and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL is above 225.0, it indicates a high-inflation, tight-money regime where monetary policy is restrictive, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 395,000 million dollars combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) in the latest quarter signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs per month combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side contraction and labor market weakness, which signals a looming recession and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 94.0 for 2 consecutive months and UNRATE > 8.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
